landmarks.name: Taipei 101
landmarks.writeup: A landmark skyscraper in Taipei, once the tallest building in the world, known for its unique design and observatory.

landmarks.name: Taroko Gorge
landmarks.writeup: A stunning marble-walled canyon in Taroko National Park, famous for its natural beauty and hiking trails.

landmarks.name: Sun Moon Lake
landmarks.writeup: Taiwan's largest freshwater lake, known for its scenic views and cultural significance to indigenous peoples.

landmarks.name: Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall
landmarks.writeup: A national monument in Taipei dedicated to the former leader Chiang Kai-shek.

landmarks.name: Alishan National Scenic Area
landmarks.writeup: A mountainous area famous for sunrise views, forest railway, and indigenous culture.

cultural_events.name: Lunar New Year
cultural_events.writeup: The most important traditional festival, celebrated with family reunions, feasts, and various customs.

cultural_events.name: Dragon Boat Festival
cultural_events.writeup: A festival featuring dragon boat races and eating zongzi (sticky rice dumplings) to commemorate poet Qu Yuan.

cultural_events.name: Mid-Autumn Festival
cultural_events.writeup: A harvest festival celebrated with mooncakes, lanterns, and family gatherings.

cultural_events.name: Taiwan Lantern Festival
cultural_events.writeup: An annual event showcasing elaborate lantern displays and cultural performances.

cultural_events.name: Ghost Festival
cultural_events.writeup: A traditional Taoist and Buddhist festival honoring the spirits of the deceased.

food_writeup: Taiwanese cuisine is known for its diverse street food, night markets, and dishes such as beef noodle soup, bubble tea, oyster omelette, and stinky tofu, reflecting a blend of Chinese, indigenous, and Japanese influences.
brief_history: Taiwan has a complex history involving indigenous peoples, Dutch and Spanish colonization, Qing dynasty rule, Japanese occupation (1895-1945), and the Republic of China's government relocating there after 1949. It has developed into a democratic and economically advanced society.

important_people.name: Chiang Kai-shek
important_people.description: Former leader of the Republic of China

important_people.name: Sun Yat-sen
important_people.description: Founding father of the Republic of China

important_people.name: Lee Teng-hui
important_people.description: First democratically elected president of Taiwan

current_conflicts: Taiwan faces ongoing political and military tensions with the People's Republic of China, which claims Taiwan as part of its territory. Taiwan maintains de facto independence with its own government and military.
